description: Western Province Provincial Council - Notification made under Clause 154E of the 13th Amendment to the Constitution of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka  - Reserved on 2019.04.21
reasoning: This gazette content announces the dissolution of the Western Province Provincial Council, which is a specific electoral process matter related to the administration of provincial councils under the Sri Lankan constitutional framework. It falls under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with the dissolution of an elected body (provincial council) and is made under constitutional provisions governing such electoral processes.
